products.product_description: Label reads in part "***Oregon RAIN Natural VIRGIN WATER***" The product is packaged in a blue colored plastic bottle. 16.9 FL OZ. Case contains 12/16.9 FL OZ. or 24/16.9 FL OZ.
products.product_quantity: 90 cases of the 24 pack and 228 cases of the 12 pack
products.code_info: Lot code 061616## : ## The two digits : two digits at the end of the code represent the time the bottle was capped in the bottling line. 061616 represents June 16, 1016; 16.9 fl oz. Bottle - UPC 8 11033 90911 2 Cases contain either 12 or 24 bottles
products.reason_for_recall: Eola Bottling Company is recalling one lot code of Oregon Rain bottled water due to mold.
